title.narrative: Emergency Support for people affected by Flash Floods in Gokwe District

description.narrative: The project aims to alleviate the negative effects on affected Households from the storm and high rainfall in Gokwe South wards 9 and 15 on their livelihoods.

The project intends to mitigate the storm and extreme rainfall in Gokwe South in wards 9 and 15, which destroyed crops, livelihoods, and houses. The project will distribute NFIs and promote hygiene and health to 30.842 affected people as a humanitarian response. The 244 most affected families will get one-time, multipurpose monetary relief to meet their immediate food and commodity requirements from the program. 201 storm-destroyed homes will get multifunctional funds for shelter from the program. As the community recovers, all 445 Households will get a second food aid cash transfer to give 2003 persons with emergency food. The project will provide beans and cow peas seeds to 244 households to reduce food insecurity induced by the storm.
